boundary.source: Sri Lanka National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI), Srilanka/Boundaries MapServer, District Boundary layer 3
boundary.membership_rule: The supplied coordinate must be covered by the district polygon; addresses or query wording alone do not establish district membership.

discovery.pagination: No pagination option is documented by mzc --help; queries reaching 500 results must be subdivided.
discovery.result_origin_or_license: Owner-supplied collection; collection methodology and origin were not investigated. The documented CLI output does not expose redistribution license metadata; no provider attribution is inferred.
discovery.independent_place_verification: not performed; imported listings remain unverified
discovery.capture_log_note: Four preliminary successful administrative-area queries returned responses that were not retained, so their result counts are unknown and excluded. Two documented invocations were interrupted before capture and later retried successfully. Two query runners briefly overlapped; retained responses were reconciled by unique query, but the exact number of redundant calls cannot be reconstructed. Confirmed invocation count is therefore a lower bound.
